subject: Mutual Action Plan & contracting owners — Orbyt Analytics
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Brooks <samantha@orbytanalytics.com>, Daniel Chen <daniel@orbytanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & contracting owners — Orbyt Analytics

Samantha / Daniel —

Thanks again for taking time yesterday. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a brief Mutual Action Plan (MAP) thread so we have a single place to align on roles, milestones, and the redline/contracting flow. Attaching a lightweight MAP template and the initial SOW draft for reference.

High level ask: please confirm who on your side will own commercial/terms (redlines) and who will own the procurement checklist (PO/finance). On our side I’ve copied the owners we’ll assign.

Attached: Redwood_MAP_Template_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
          SOW-draft.pdf (PDF, draft)

Proposed initial milestones (dates are placeholders until we sync):
- MAP kickoff call: target this week (30–45 min) — owner: Rishi Malhotra
- Security questionnaire + evidence: target by 2/18 — owner: Laura Bennett (Redwood security)
- Contract redlines returned: target by 2/18 — owner: Orbyt legal / procurement
- Commercial signoff (finance/PO/approved pricing): target by 2/25 — owner: Karthik Iyer
- Final signature / execution: target by 3/5 — mutual

Redline process notes: we can accept a single consolidated .docx with redlines or use in-browser DocuSign comments if that’s preferred. If Orbyt prefers track-changes back to the SOW, we’ll mirror changes and prepare an execution-ready version for signature.

Please reply with: 1) names/emails of the terms owner(s) and 2) any hard constraints on timeline or procurement steps (e.g., committee review dates, PO lead times). Once we have owners we’ll schedule the kickoff call and circulate an updated MAP with tasks assigned.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

Thanks Rishi — and great to meet yesterday.

Confirming Orbyt contacts for contracting/procurement: Daniel Chen (daniel@orbytanalytics.com) will be our legal/contracts lead; I’ll be coordinating procurement items (PO, vendor setup) and will loop in finance when pricing is confirmed.

Timeline constraints from our side: we have an internal procurement committee meeting the week of 2/22 (final approvals need to be queued before that). For the redline process we prefer a single consolidated redline document (.docx) returned to us; Orbyt legal will review and then provide annotated comments. We aim to return redlines within 5 business days of receiving the SOW if there are no major open items.

Small ask on evidence — Daniel, can you confirm if you need SOC 2 type II report or just the summary + attest? We can produce either but need to know what level of detail your committee will require.

Also attaching our procurement checklist for reference: Orbyt_Procurement_Reqs.docx (we’ll upload PO template once pricing is agreed).

Looking forward to the kickoff call — Samantha

Samantha Brooks
Head of IT Procurement | Orbyt Analytics
samantha@orbytanalytics.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

Thanks Samantha — great, that timeline is clear and very helpful. Quick internal alignment and confirmed owners on our side: 
- Commercial & contracting owner (pricing, PO terms): Karthik Iyer (karthik@redwood.com)
- Technical evaluation & integration point-of-contact: Marissa Cole (marissa@redwood.com)
- Security/compliance / evidence collection: Laura Bennett (laura@redwood.com)
- Program lead / MAP owner: Rishi Malhotra (me)

Next steps (I’ll own scheduling and tracking in the MAP):
1) I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff this Friday 2/13 at 11:00 AM PST (invite to follow) — purpose: align on the MAP, confirm dates, and agree redline handling.
2) Samantha / Daniel: please circulate the consolidated redline doc against the SOW by 2/18 if possible. If Orbyt needs additional security artifacts (SOC2 type II), Laura will coordinate and can provide the summary and contact for the auditor.
3) Karthik: prepare the commercial summary and the PO language we should expect to see from Orbyt — aim to have that ready for the kickoff so procurement knows what to expect.
4) I’ll update the attached MAP template with owners and HubSpot links after the kickoff. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ORB-2026-042

Target milestones we’re proposing (to be finalized on the call):
- Redlines returned by Orbyt: 2/18
- Internal legal + procurement review (both sides): 2/19–2/24
- Commercial/PO approvals: 2/25
- Final signoff & signature: 3/5

If anyone has hard blockers on those dates please reply-all and call out the constraint. Otherwise I’ll send a calendar invite for 2/13 and an updated MAP spreadsheet afterwards.

Thanks all — let’s keep it tight.

—
